entries.zh: 赤脚，光着脚；赤足行走
entries.en: barefoot; to go barefoot, without shoes
entries.notes: 西语词头 Descabio 非常规拼写，疑为 descalzo/descalbo（赤脚）之变形或误读；汉、M、R 三栏赤脚义互证清晰。

entries.zh: 宽舒宽心，安适宽缓；宽松宽裕（不迫不严）
entries.en: rest, ease; to be relaxed and unhurried; lenient, gentle; wide, spacious
entries.notes: 西语栏 'soa ch' 后残缺、M 栏截断；据 H 宽、M/R cuan 与 Descanso 定宽舒安适义。

entries.zh: 歇息，休息；停歇
entries.en: rest; to rest, take a rest, pause

entries.zh: 住宿，过夜歇宿；旅次投宿
entries.en: to lodge, stay overnight; night's lodging
entries.notes: 官话对音 zu/ju 存疑；宿义据汉、M、L 三栏明确。

entries.zh: 休息，安歇；止息、停歇
entries.en: rest, repose; to rest from labor; to cease, to stop
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 fit/sit 存疑，不影响词义；据 H 息与西语 'holgar sin trabaxo'（不劳而息）定歇息义。

entries.zh: 歇脚过夜，投宿（途中歇宿）
entries.en: to lodge for the night, put up overnight; lodging

entries.zh: 止歇，平息；歇息安闲
entries.en: to cease, to stop; to rest and take one's ease; repose

entries.zh: 睡觉，歇息睡眠；小睡（歇睏）
entries.en: to sleep, take a nap; to rest by sleeping

entries.zh: 睡卧安眠，睡中歇息
entries.en: to rest sleeping; to sleep, be asleep

entries.zh: 闭口，住嘴；不再说话
entries.en: to shut one's mouth, keep silent; to stop talking
entries.notes: 首字疑：喙/口（M chuy 支持喙）；第三字'档'与对音 sau 不合、字形存疑；据西语 'no hablar' 定闭口不言义。

entries.zh: 歇脚；旅途歇息、落脚住宿
entries.en: to rest one's feet; to stop for a rest and put up (on a journey)

entries.zh: 歇宿过夜，投宿一晚
entries.en: to lodge overnight, stay the night
entries.notes: 第二字疑：暝/具；据 R meng 对暝与西语 'hospedarse' 过夜义取暝。

entries.zh: 安歇；安顿歇息、安然就寝
entries.en: to rest at ease; to settle down to rest, retire to rest

entries.zh: 倚靠椅背稍歇片刻；靠坐歇一会儿
entries.en: to lean back and rest a while (in a chair); to recline briefly
entries.notes: 首字'勒'与 M tit、R chy 对音不合，疑另有本字；据西语 'recostarse en la silla' 定倚椅稍歇义。

entries.zh: 快意愉悦，舒畅欢喜；安适痛快
entries.en: delight, pleasure; ease and relief
entries.notes: 首字疑：慨/快；R cāy 对 kuài 支持'快'，取快悦（愉悦、宽慰安适）义。

entries.zh: 卸下；卸货（把船上货物卸下来）
entries.en: to unload, discharge (a ship's cargo); to take off a load
entries.notes: 西语头词 'navio, de…' 后残缺、M 疑 sa/soa；据 H 卸与 R sīe 定卸船卸货义（马尼拉大帆船贸易语境）。

entries.zh: 放下担子歇力；卸下肩挑之担
entries.en: to lay down one's shoulder-pole load, rest from carrying; to unburden

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺，第二字疑：冷/令，且 M chin、R king 与冷/令对音皆不合，全词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 诉说冤屈，叫屈申冤；诉告冤枉
entries.en: to complain of injustice, cry one's wrongs; to unburden a grievance
entries.notes: 西语头词残缺（'des descar…'）；诉冤枉义据汉、M、R 三栏明确。

entries.zh: 告状投诉；控告、诉告申理
entries.en: to lodge a complaint, bring suit; to complain, accuse
entries.notes: 西语头词残缺；第二字疑：告/苦，M co（ko）支持告，取诉告、告状义。

entries.zh: 春风；和暖春风、温煦宜人；如沐春风（安适舒畅）
entries.en: spring breeze; mild genial wind; (fig.) warm comfort, ease
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（'con sus tentos' 前后不全）、与春风配合不明；春风义据汉、M、R 三栏明确。
